design.mechanism:
ONE flag FR13_TREE_CONV_FUSED=1 enables all items (FIX-2 one-flag-many-items pattern). Mechanism per census contributor — VECTORIZED TORCH + INIT-TIME STATIC INDEX TENSORS everywhere; NO new Triton kernel in FIX-3 (Phase B fallback documented):

(1) WRITE-BACK LOOP (44-52%) -> init-time static gather table + ONE index_select + the existing index_copy_ (class 3 gather-then-scatter; targets disjoint). New table per (topology,width,state_len): state_src[i,j] = p if p<w-1 else (w-1+path_i[p-(w-1)] if j<w-1 else Z), p=path_len_i+j, Z=w-1+tree_n -> a shared zero row. Build ONE source_z=cat(prior.T, x, zero_row[1,10240]) — REUSES the window's existing cat (appending the zero row provably does not perturb window indices, executed check below); new_states=source_z.index_select(0,state_src.flat).view(tree_n,12,10240).transpose(1,2).contiguous(); conv_state.index_copy_ unchanged. 7*tree_n+2 nodes -> 3. The per-node arange/new_zeros/cat/cat/index_select all die; the zero row is an init-cached persistent [1,dim] bf16 (FIX-2 layer-keyed cache pattern :1358-1407: populate on first NON-capturing forward; capture-time miss builds without retaining). Batched over B by flattening source to [(B*(tree_n+w)),dim] with per-b row offsets baked into a B-keyed cached index (B fixed per capture family).
(2) TAP/BIAS/SILU (20%) -> vectorized torch, REDUCTIONS BANNED: prod_bf16 = window * conv_weights.t().unsqueeze(0) ([tree_n,4,10240]x[1,4,10240]; .t() is a VIEW, no cast kernel — runtime assert conv_weights.dtype==x.dtype==conv_state.dtype else RuntimeError); prod_f32=prod_bf16.to(f32); acc=bias.to(f32).view(1,-1)+prod_f32[:,0]; acc=acc+prod_f32[:,1]; +[:,2]; +[:,3] — FOUR EXPLICIT ADDS, torch.sum FORBIDDEN (reduction order unspecified); out=triton_ex2_silu_bf16(acc, bf16) — the SAME kernel object, same BLOCK=256, and for B=1 the same n constexpr => same compiled specialization, zero new codegen. Drops x.float() and the bias clone (broadcast add has identical per-element operand pairs). ~19 nodes -> ~7.
(3) REMAP FOLD (10.5%) -> prepared-rows split: shared row math (ks/valid/src_col/dst_col/2x gather -> src_rows,dst_rows [B*path_cols] i64) computed ONCE per forward in the first-executing GDN layer of EACH kv-cache group (3 computes/fwd on the cu130 3-group split — value-identical, ordering-safe, avoids cross-group assumptions), written into init-time persistent module-global buffers (rebuild+re-export per builder init = the FIX-2 group-union/5x-re-init license; capture happens after the LAST init). Per layer: new fr13_tree_conv_fused.replay_conv_state_linear_remap_prepared(conv_state, src_rows, dst_rows) = index_select + index_copy_ (2 nodes). fr13_replay_conv_remap.py stays FROZEN as the OFF arm. Identical permutation, identical materialize-before-scatter order. Row math is remap-independent (reads only accepted paths/lens + spec indices, which no remap mutates) so once-per-group is exact. FULL ELISION (remap is a provably shadowed dead store in the fused path: every dst row = window col k<len<=tree_n is rewritten by the write-back's full-logical-row publish to window cols 0..tree_n-1 later in the SAME forward) is documented but NOT enabled — future FR13_TREE_CONV_FUSED_ELIDE_REMAP=0 pending full-bank live proof + mid-forward native-reader audit (class 8).
(4) PRIOR-GATHER FOLD (9.5%) -> same prepared-rows split: read_node_cols/bank_rows [B,1] once per group-first layer; per layer keeps ONLY index_select(conv_state,0,bank_rows) IN-LAYER and PRE-remap (per-layer snapshot semantics preserved exactly). New sibling fn gather_committed_path_conv_prior_prepared(); kernel-module fn :281-334 frozen for OFF. 10 -> 1 node/layer.
(5) TRIVIALS: fused branch has no _fr10_weight_f; no aranges (indices all static tables); path0_x keeps FIX-2 gated-move semantics (computed only inside FR10_METRICS/capture branches from unmutated _fr10_x). With FR10_METRICS=1+fused, the diag block runs against per-b slices of the batched fused tensors (identical values => identical diag); diagnostic-only combos FR12_NATIVE_SPINE_ORACLE / FR12_TREE_CONV_NATIVE_PRIOR_READ / FR12_TREE_CONV_STATE_FULL_CAPTURE / FR13_CONV_REPLAY_NODES / FR12_SUBKERNEL_CAPTURE with fused=1 -> RuntimeError fail-loud (run those with fused=0; class 9, no silent interplay). Handoff env (:1834-1858) supported via per-b slice views.
PHASE B (NOT FIX-3; only if post-gate residual demands): one per-layer Triton kernel fusing C+D+E+F, reading the PRIOR SNAPSHOT tensor not the live bank (kills the cross-CTA read/write race on the leaf row), grid (B*tree_n, cdiv(10240,BLOCK)); explicit tl.cast(x32*w32, bfloat16).to(f32) between mul and add pins the bf16 round-trip AND structurally blocks FMA contraction; tl.exp silu; per-layer launch passes tensors as ARGS (arg-anchored, NO pointer tables, NO tl.pointer_type casts — the AxisInfo precedent); ~3 nodes/layer; class 10 byte A/B re-armed for the new compile. New code lives in src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr13_tree_conv_fused.py (importable for tests, like fr13_replay_conv_remap).
design.bitExactArgument:
Per-op correspondence, with EXECUTED CPU evidence for the two arithmetic-free/arithmetic-bearing cores (run this session): legacy write-back loop vs static-index gather = int16-view byte-identical across {chain5, cat9 caterpillar, branchy, single-node} x widths 2..6 x state_len {w-1,8,12} including bf16 subnormal injections (ALL_IDENTITIES_HOLD), and the appended zero row provably leaves window indices' output bytes unchanged; legacy per-col tap accumulation vs batched-mul + explicit ordered adds = int32-view byte-identical (TAPS_BYTE_EQUAL True). Arguments per class of op:
(a) DATA MOVEMENT (write-back, window gather, prior/remap row gathers, index_copy_, cat, slice copies): gathers/copies are per-element pure moves with no arithmetic, no dtype change (cat already requires uniform dtype in legacy; .to(conv_state.dtype) is bf16->bf16 identity); the static index table is the closed-form composition of the loop's index math — CPU-provable exhaustively per topology (test 1). Byte-exact unconditionally, GPU included.
(b) ELEMENTWISE ARITHMETIC (taps, casts, adds): vectorizing changes launch geometry, never the per-element function. bf16 mul = fp32-convert -> mul (EXACT: 8x8-bit mantissas fit 24) -> RNE, identical in every TensorIterator instantiation; broadcast vs expanded-clone operands are value-identical; operand ORDER preserved verbatim (bias+p0, then +p1..+p3 — addition kept in legacy operand order, no commutation relied on); the fp32->bf16->fp32 round-trip boundaries are the SAME .to() ops. The ONLY reorder hazard is a reduction op — therefore torch.sum/einsum/matmul are BANNED in the fused branch; explicit adds only.
(c) SILU: same _fr13_ex2_silu_kernel object from fr13_ex2_silu.py, same BLOCK=256 constexpr, same n constexpr at B=1 (n=tree_n*10240) => the SAME compiled binary, not a recompile. (B>1 would specialize a new n — same source, GPU A/B covers; B=1 deployed.)
(d) ORDERING/STATE CONTRACTS: per-layer sequence gather-snapshot -> remap -> conv compute -> write-back preserved; prepared row math hoisted only because it reads tensors (accepted paths/lens, spec indices) that nothing in the interval mutates; the bank index_select snapshot stays in-layer pre-remap. Write-back dst rows: legacy already used one index_copy_ per b over distinct node columns; batching over B relies on deployed disjoint per-request windows (same precondition FIX-2's byte A/B encodes, tests/test_fr13_eager_pack_replay_byte_ab.py:85-96).
(e) The bf16-tap order, cast boundaries, and silu op order — THE FR11-overturning fixes — are reproduced as the SAME ops on the SAME values, not re-derived math (math-correct != bit-exact; no per-stage tolerances anywhere; the proof is the int-view byte A/B + live gate, the CPU identities are necessary-not-sufficient per class 8/10).

Default flip to ON only after: synthetic byte A/B green (GPU) + capture-payload A/B green + live gate (below) — the FR13_EAGER_PACK :91 default-ON-after-gate precedent.
design.byteABSpec:
New tests/test_fr13_tree_conv_fused_byte_ab.py (FIX-2 test structure: int-view equality, NEVER atol; bf16 -> .view(torch.int16), fp32 -> .view(torch.int32), index rows -> int64 equal) + fused impl AND a verbatim legacy-reference replica both importable from src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr13_tree_conv_fused.py (replica pinned to the patcher text by wiring substring asserts + anchored to LIVE legacy by the capture-payload arm).
INPUT MATRIX: topologies {chain5 [(0,),(0,0),...x5], cat9 9-node caterpillar (exact deployed SPEC_CONFIG tree read from the launch scripts at test time), branchy depth-3 with 2 siblings, single-node}; width 2..6 x state_len {width-1, 8, 12 (deployed)}; accepted_len {0 (zero-accept -> node-col-0 prior read), 1, partial, full}; BRANCH-winner non-monotone accepted paths (e.g. [2,6,7,9] — the FIX-2 test's shape); B {1, 2-with-disjoint-windows}; bf16 edge values injected at chosen rows {+-0, min subnormal 0x0001/0x8001, max subnormal, 1.0+-1ulp, RNE-tie products, +-inf, NaN (copy paths), silu saturation +-88}; 3 seeds.
CPU-RUNNABLE (this class of host, no GPU): (T1) index-composition identity — static state_src table vs the legacy loop's index math, exhaustive per (node,col) via arange value-tensors [EXECUTED THIS SESSION: ALL_IDENTITIES_HOLD]; (T2) write-back data movement — legacy loop vs fused gather, int16-view of the stacked states; (T3) taps/adds — legacy per-col accumulation vs batched mul + explicit adds, int32-view of acc (pre-silu) [EXECUTED: TAPS_BYTE_EQUAL True] (CPU silu fallback is NOT ex2 — the activation comparison is GPU-only, both arms must call the same fn so CPU equality is data-movement-meaningful only); (T4) prepared-rows — gather_committed_path_conv_prior_prepared + replay_conv_state_linear_remap_prepared vs the frozen library fns, ALL accepted_len cases, WHOLE-bank int-view equality including untouched rows (bleed detection), plus the PAGE-BOUNDARY case: conv bank as as_strided view over a padded page with sentinel bytes in the ssm gap, sentinels asserted byte-untouched in both arms.
GPU-GATED (skipif CUDA+triton, the test_fr13_eager_pack_replay_byte_ab pytestmark): (T5) full per-layer pipeline synthetic A/B — legacy reference (real triton_ex2_silu_bf16) vs fused from bit-identical inputs; compare conv1d_out rows [0,B*tree_n) int16-view (padded rows are uninitialized in BOTH arms — excluded, documented) AND the FULL conv bank int16-view; all topologies/lens/edges; (T6) capture-payload A/B — FR12_SUBKERNEL_CAPTURE tree_conv_detail payloads (pre_conv + prior windows + weights/bias + state indices; capture a fresh PAIRED payload on the GPU host if absent — the capture-once pinned-prompt rule) fed to both arms, int-view equality — this is the live-legacy anchor; (T7) B=2 disjoint-window batching incl. the silu n-respecialization.
LIVE GATE (follow-up GPU workflow, binding; offline = necessary not sufficient, class 8): B=1 same-seed bit-identical repeat FIRST; ON-vs-OFF served-stream byte-identity at greedy AND temp 0.6; accept/event EXACTLY unchanged; nospec arm pristine; needle present in BOTH states; full-CUDA-graph capture boot health (builder-init needle x5, capture completes, no pool growth); THEN speed, basis request_decode_time_seconds_sum / spec_decode_num_drafts_total only.
design.projections: ALL ESTIMATES (class 12 labels; binding numbers come from the live gate). Captured device nodes per GDN layer (live path): chain5 ~95 -> ~18-20; cat9 ~124-134 -> ~18-20 — the fused count is TOPOLOGY-INDEPENDENT (tree_n multiplier eliminated): [A]1 + [B]2 + [C]3 (cat absorbs the zero row) + [D]~7 + [E]1 + [F]3 + 2 allocs + ~6-8 once-per-group prepared-row nodes amortized /16 layers. Per-forward: chain5 -(3,600-3,800) of the ~5,040 extra captured nodes (~73-76%); cat9 -(5,100-5,600) of ~6,400 (~80-87%) — brackets the census intervention-3 projection (-4,300/-5,600). Remaining extra nodes: replay ring staging ~385 (keep, net-positive), fused_post_conv_prep + scan section ~145, residual conv ~900. Graph-launch CPU: cudaGraphLaunch API p90 192us -> est ~80-100us (node count ~3x down on the dominant family); capture/boot time per graph family down proportionally (minutes-class, unmeasured). WALL: census bounds the whole tree-GDN captured section <=10 ms/fwd (no-tree-GDN discriminator) with conv emulation est 3-8 ms; node-proportional reclaim est 2.5-7 ms (chain5): 0.2257 -> est 0.2187-0.2232 s/fwd = 1.002x-1.023x native (0.2182). chain5 <=1.0x VERDICT: plausible ONLY at the favorable end of the band (conv share >=7.5 ms incl. launch-CPU reclaim) — NOT guaranteed; if the post-FIX-3 residual is still >1.0x the next ranked contributor is the eager committer serialization (census intervention 1, est 35-60 ms class on the pre-FIX-1 basis, partially addressed by FIX-2). cat9: reclaim est 4-10 ms -> 0.2349 -> est 0.225-0.231 = 1.03-1.06x; if the ~17 ms residual really is conv-dominated at the upper end, ~1.01x is reachable; the conv share there is the larger absolute because of the 1.4x node count. Phase B Triton kernel would add only ~700-800 more nodes saved (est <=1-2 ms) for a full class-10 recompile risk — deferred unless the gate shows the residual is still node-bound.
design.risks: (1) Reduction-order regression: any future "cleanup" replacing the explicit 4 adds with sum()/einsum breaks bit-exactness silently — wiring test pins the explicit-add sequence textually. (2) index_copy_ duplicate-dst across batch rows is undefined: deployed windows are per-request disjoint (KV pool), legacy per-b loop was last-writer-wins; batched form is NOT covered for overlapping windows — documented non-goal, B=2 disjoint case in the A/B. (3) Prepared-rows hoist assumes group-first-layer executes before its group's other layers (model order) and that accepted paths/lens are not mutated mid-forward — both true today; mitigated by computing per kv-cache GROUP (3x) not once globally, and by the union-invariant assert. (4) cu130 5x-builder-re-init/group-union regression (the exact FIX-2 cat9_on failure): rebuild+re-export per init + boot-log needle; first ON boot is watched, not fired-and-forgotten. (5) Capture-time static-table cache miss would allocate inside capture: FIX-2 license (build-without-retain) + needle field static_tables=1 asserts warm population; eager warmup precedes capture in this stack. (6) mixed_qkv_spec rows beyond B*tree_n are uninitialized garbage in BOTH arms — byte A/B compares only written rows; the live ON-vs-OFF stream identity is the binding end-to-end check. (7) dtype/layout drift (e.g. future fp8 conv state) breaks the no-op-cast assumptions — fail-loud dtype-uniformity assert at engagement. (8) Legacy-reference replica in tests can drift from the patcher text — anchored by capture-payload A/B (T6, real live bytes) + wiring substring asserts; review obligation noted. (9) Remap ELISION is NOT shipped: the shadow-store proof covers in-forward readers only; class 8 demands a full-bank live byte proof + audit of native cross/mid-step writers (get_temporal_copy_spec-class) before any elision flag. (10) Phase B Triton kernel = new compile, class 10 (shared source != shared SASS) — byte A/B re-armed per toolchain, arg-anchored addressing only, deferred. (11) Class 12: every wall/node number above is an estimate from the census; speed verdicts only from per-request decode seconds on the live gate; B=1 same-seed repeat is the first gate. (12) Diagnostic-env combinations are fail-loud-excluded with fused=1 (oracle/capture work runs fused=0) — gates that need FR10_METRICS=1 still work (diag recomputes off per-b slices, values identical).
design.summary: FIX-3 design (CPU-only, no commits): fuse the tree causal-conv Python emulation in scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py (live-path ops mapped at current HEAD lines :1183/:1219/:1497-1511/:1774-1790/:1798-1833; census line refs drifted post-FIX-2). Chosen mechanism = vectorized torch + init-time static index tensors, NO new Triton kernel: (1) the per-node state write-back loop (the tree_n multiplier, 44-52% of extra nodes) becomes one static-index gather + the existing index_copy_ — pure data movement, and the index-composition identity plus the appended-zero-row window invariance were EXECUTED and verified byte-identical on CPU this session across chain5/cat9/branchy/single x widths 2-6 x state_len {3,8,12}; (2) taps/bias/silu vectorize to one bf16 mul + one fp32 cast + four EXPLICIT ordered adds (sum() banned) + the SAME triton_ex2_silu_bf16 binary (n constexpr unchanged at B=1) — also executed byte-identical on CPU; (3)+(4) remap and committed-prior gathers split into once-per-group prepared row math + 1-2 per-layer bank ops via new sibling fns in src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr13_tree_conv_fused.py (frozen library fns = OFF arm); remap full-elision identified as a shadowed dead store but deferred pending class-8 proof.
